reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text: The texture is very watery and feels good on the skin, i was recommended from a friend saying this helps with her acne. I used it when my skin is very sensitive and it did not sting but i have not got visible result on how it improve my acne yet ( i don’t have a lot of acne )
reviews.zh: 質地好清水，塗喺皮膚上感覺好好。朋友推薦我用，話呢款對佢嘅暗瘡有幫助。我皮膚好敏感嗰陣用過，冇刺痛，但係暫時未見到對暗瘡有咩明顯改善（我嘅暗瘡唔多）。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text: A really great serum for combination and oily skin. It has a lightweight, watery texture that doesn't weigh the skin down. It absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness or residue. It also helps keep my skin less oily throughout the day. It worked really well for me
reviews.zh: 係一款非常適合混合皮同油性皮膚嘅精華液。質地輕盈、清水感，唔會令皮膚感覺沉重。吸收好快，唔會留低任何黏膩感或殘留。佢亦有助整日都令皮膚唔咁油。對我嚟講效果非常好。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text: My skin doesn't get oily in the morning, so I think it works, but I want to test it out for a month to see its effect. I like its texture, and it smells nice cuz it doesn't have much smell as a person with sensitive nose.
reviews.zh: 我朝早嘅皮膚冇咁油，所以我覺得佢有效，但係我想試一個月，睇吓效果。我鍾意佢嘅質地，而且味道好好，因為佢冇乜味，對我呢個鼻子敏感嘅人嚟講好啱。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text:
I've been using the numbuzin No. 1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum for a few weeks, and I'm very pleased with the results. The serum has a lightweight, non-sticky texture that absorbs quickly into the skin and feels comfortable both morning and night.

It provides great hydration while helping to calm redness and irritation. Whenever my skin feels stressed or sensitive, this serum helps soothe it and leaves my skin feeling balanced and refreshed. I've also noticed that my skin looks healthier and feels smoother with consistent use.

Another thing I appreciate is that it layers well with other skincare products and doesn't cause pilling. It's a gentle yet effective serum that helps support the skin barrier while providing lasting moisture. Overall, it's a great choice for sensitive, dehydrated, or easily irritated skin, and I would definitely repurchase it.
reviews.zh:
我用 numbuzin No. 1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 已經幾個禮拜，對效果非常滿意。呢款精華質地輕盈、唔黏，吸收得好快，早晚都用得好舒服。

佢提供好好嘅保濕，同時有助舒緩泛紅同刺激。每當我皮膚感到有壓力或者敏感嗰陣，呢款精華都幫我舒緩，令皮膚感覺平衡、清爽。我亦留意到，持續使用之後，皮膚睇落更健康、摸落更順滑。

另外一樣我欣賞嘅係，佢同其他護膚產品配搭都好好，唔會搓泥。呢款係一款溫和但有效嘅精華，幫助支持皮膚屏障，同時提供持久嘅保濕。整體嚟講，對於敏感、缺水或者容易刺激嘅皮膚，呢款係好好嘅選擇，我一定會再買。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Not bad. Sometime it is sticker when applying with the other serum.
reviews.zh: 唔錯。有時同其他精華一齊塗嗰陣會有少少黏。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I really love this product. The quality is consistently great, and it has become one of my favorites. I'm already restocking because it's so useful, and I will definitely purchase it again in the future
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款產品。質素一直都好好，已經成為我最愛嘅其中一款。因為好實用，我已經再次補貨，將來一定會再買。

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I like the toner so I thought I'd try the serum and I'm glad I did! It's really soothing and makes my skin feel instantly softer and smoother! Really happy with my purchase :)
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢款化妝水，所以諗住試吓精華，而家好開心自己有試！佢真係好舒緩，即刻令皮膚感覺更加柔軟、順滑！對呢次購買真係好滿意 :)

reviews.shade: numbuzin No.1 Pantothenic B5 Active Soothing Serum 50ml
reviews.text: This is my second purchase of this serum. I use it twice a week at night. Clears up my texture and leaves my skin smooth and hydrated in the morning. Absolutely love this serum so much.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次買呢款精華。我每星期夜晚用兩次。改善咗膚質，早上起身時，皮膚順滑又滋潤。我真係好鍾意呢款精華。
